snippet.title: Video Ghastlies - World Premiere Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Video Ghastlies is a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".
